row: Monash Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences

The Faculty of Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences at Monash University is internationally recognised for excellence in teaching, learning and research. Hear about some of our latest research breakthroughs and how we are improving the health and well being of individuals and communities. Our graduates also talk about exciting career opportunities in health as well as postgraduate study options.
